symbols.name: prime radix
symbols.meaning: The prime radix of the stored digits.
symbols.quote: Fix a prime $q$, the radix of the stored digits (on this page $q$ is a prime, not a sequence length).

symbols.name: field digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of base-q digits of a field.
symbols.quote: Let $b\ge1$ be the number of base-$q$ digits of a field (this $b$ is not the lowest bit of an index).

symbols.name: field size
symbols.meaning: The number of values a field can take, q^b.
symbols.quote: Put $Q=q^b$, the number of values a field can take, and let $V$ be the array volume, the number of stored base-$q$ digits.

symbols.name: field value
symbols.meaning: The value of the target field, between 0 and Q-1.
symbols.quote: The target field has value $y\in\{0,\dots,Q-1\}$ (here $y$ is a field value, not the ring variable) and follows a fixed number of control fields.

symbols.name: offset
symbols.meaning: The offset added to the target field, prepared from the control values.
symbols.quote: where $a$ is the offset, prepared from the control values (here $a$ is not a bank index).

symbols.name: suffix digit count
symbols.meaning: The number of digits that follow the target field.
symbols.quote: Let $B$ be the number of digits that follow the target (here $B$ is not the number of entries per row).

symbols.name: scaling integer
symbols.meaning: A fixed positive integer prime to q, by which the field is multiplied.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be a fixed positive integer prime to $q$ (not the machine constant).

symbols.name: wrap count
symbols.meaning: The number of times cy wraps past Q.
symbols.quote: The map $y\mapsto cy \pmod Q$ sends the block at position $y$ to position $y'=cy-jQ$, where $j=\lfloor cy/Q\rfloor$ counts how often $cy$ wraps past $Q$ (this $j$ is not a wrapped position).

relations.quote: Each update is carried out by splitting into streams and merging back, as in [Elementary stream operations](stream-ops.md).
